title: Engine fire hits fast craft bound for Leyte, over 300 rescued
summary: More than 300 passengers aboard a fast craft bound for Leyte were safely rescued on Sunday, November 22, 2026, after an engine fire broke out on the vessel off the coast of Cebu.
